realm_description: A dense, patient forest that rewards those willing to grow at nature's pace. Trust, healing, and quiet resilience all take shape here, far from the noise of the capitals.

primary.label: Custodian
primary.description: Refuses to let a tradition, language, or way of life slip away; care is not nostalgia but stubborn devotion.
primary.guiding_promise: I will hold on to what matters, long after others have let it go.
trait_descriptions: Some things must not be lost.
primary.shadow_description: Guards the tradition so fiercely that nothing — not even necessary growth — is allowed through.

secondary.label: Builder
secondary.description: Driven to make things real with their own hands.
secondary.guiding_promise: I will make something real that endures long after I am gone.
secondary.shadow_description: Cannot put the work down long enough to notice what it has quietly cost them.

wheel.central_question: Should we imagine tomorrow, or preserve yesterday?

growth.label: Builder
growth.description: Driven to make things real with their own hands.
growth.guiding_promise: I will make something real that endures long after I am gone.
growth.shadow_description: Cannot put the work down long enough to notice what it has quietly cost them.

other_ally.label: Warden
other_ally.description: Guards boundaries that others don't even know exist; constant, thankless watch.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will hold this line, long after everyone else has forgotten why it matters.
other_ally.shadow_description: Stands watch so long they start seeing threats at a threshold nothing is actually crossing.

quarter.label: Survivor
quarter.description: Endures; resilience is the value they hold above all others.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will rise from the ash, proving that our light cannot be crushed.
quarter.shadow_description: Treats every calm moment as the quiet before the next disaster, and lets no one close enough to prove otherwise.

opposite.label: Visionary
opposite.description: Sees the shape of what doesn't exist yet; sketches futures vivid enough to pull the world forward.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will keep dreaming even when the world insists on staying as it is.
opposite.shadow_description: Gets so lost sketching tomorrow that today is left to fend for itself.

realmmate.label: Sage
realmmate.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
realmmate.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

wheel.compatible_text: Sage · Historian — fellow travelers of The Living Forest.
